blocks.text: Kabhi force constant nahi hoti aur bohat thore time ke liye lagti hai. Example: bat jab cricket ball ko marta hai to collision (takkar) ke dauran force har lamhe badalti hai. Aise mein force aur time ko alag alag dekhne ke bajaye un ka product (F⃗ × t) lena aasan hai. Time t tak lagne wali average force F aur t ka product impulse kehlata hai:

blocks.title: Example 2.6
blocks.problem: 1500 kg ki car ki velocity 3.0 s mein 20 m s⁻¹ se kam ho kar 15 m s⁻¹ reh jati hai. Retarding (rokne wali) average force kitni thi?
steps: F = -7500 kg m s⁻¹ / 3.0 s = -2500 kg m s⁻²
blocks.answer: F = -2500 N = -2.5 kN. Negative sign batata hai ke force motion ki ulti direction mein hai, yani rokne wali hai.
